name: Crystal Client
summary:
Crystal Client is a customizable VRChat companion built for Meta Quest. Create rotating OSC chatbox messages and personalize their timing, order, appearance, and included information.

Display Spotify now playing, song progress, time, weather, supported heart-rate data, AFK status, and your Quest battery level. Save custom profiles, preview messages before sending them, toggle individual integrations, and access the included avatar search providers.

Crystal Client communicates through VRChat’s supported OS
